Branch claude/route-keyed-storage, cut from origin/main at 26441a1da3. PR #1996 opened at the FIRST commit (the bean alone), before any code, per continual-progress invariant 1.

Skill content-context-and-state-graphs.md updated — where a skill and the schema disagree the skill wins and is wrong, so it moved in the same change. No declaration flipped: main stays authoritative.

Mutation-checked, this file's own practice: dropping the route `expect` refusal turns a named test red; pinning the manifest check back to the literal 'tip' turns the both-ways test AND the pre-existing corrupt-manifest test red — so neither rule is a vacuous pass. `bun run gates` (the full derived set, not a hand-chosen subset) still running at the time this token moved.

Three commits pushed to #1996: the bean, the mechanism, and the bean tick plus follow-on bean xsrv (the docs/uml/ cutover, blocked on this PR with the four blocking fields). Token now at Task_RunCI, waiting on CI for head 70c15b9576.
